sources.quote: The original Blue Yeti has been one of the most recognizable go-to USB microphones for content creators since it launched in 2009, and now it finally has a successor.
Logitech's Yeti 2 brings the 17-year-old USB mic into the modern age

claims.statement: Logitech launched the Blue Yeti 2, successor to the original USB microphone that launched in 2009.

sources.quote: the Blue Yeti 2 adds some modern upgrades, including an interactive LED display, AI de-noising, and a proximity based voice sensor

claims.statement: The Blue Yeti 2 adds an interactive LED display, AI de-noising, and a proximity-based voice sensor.

sources.quote: In case you missed it, Logitech bough Blue, actually kind of a while ago!

claims.statement: Logitech acquired Blue prior to this launch.

headline: Logitech launches Blue Yeti 2 microphone with new features
summary: Logitech launched the Blue Yeti 2, successor to the original USB microphone that debuted in 2009, adding an interactive LED display, AI de-noising, and a proximity-based voice sensor.
